theArkansasDeterminismDefect.measured: node scripts/build-census-v1-ar-pardon-seal-set.mjs, unmodified, on a clean worktree at 73b0aba89, exit 0, no error printed. It rewrote 12 committed files and left the petition fixtures at different digests: canonical 3b1576d92c2008ba2548522fd16e8025b3e4cbff1f0f40343577ab29477af9ea -> cc23d2edea3ade650dcc277c62ec5b195d2ac33fb692e833a4e95c603893da70 (222500 -> 222753 bytes), boundary 35c2c5cbf9922bed57f1e8da627bdb2b0f554dbcacf5f6de29b5390d565a36c4 -> 362b81a0375284d5ca3495b67258b9e5f7773833dd0cf018b28a167224e38d0f (222481 -> 222734 bytes). The two ORDER fixtures reproduced byte-identically.
theArkansasDeterminismDefect.cause: The petition's blank census differs. The committed map offers 14 petition anchors (canonical wrote 2, refused 12); this container's run offers 19 (wrote 3, refused 16). The caption harvest reads different characters for the same coordinates -- '5.On th' -> '5.On the', 'Ra' -> 'Rac', 'Se' -> 'Sex', 'DO' -> 'FBI No', 'A Class' -> 'A Class _' -- at identical y/x. That is a text-extraction / font-metrics difference between this container and the one that wrote the fixtures at 657036a76, not a change in the record and not a change made by this lane.
theArkansasDeterminismDefect.corroboration: VF01's own CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP note records that its local rerender was clean only 'after correcting the local font-cache configuration'. The same environment sensitivity is what this control exposes.
theArkansasDeterminismDefect.whyItMatters: It is not repairable inside a guidance grant, and it means the AR fixtures on disk cannot currently be regenerated from their own committed builder. A future lane that runs this builder to make ANY change -- including a one-word guidance change -- will silently move petition bytes and invalidate the admitted raster.

findings.whatIsThereNow: The kinds allowlist is deleted. participantActsRequiredBeforeFiling() filters on requiredBeforeFiling === true alone and returns all seven. A new guide section, '## Everything the committed record marks required before filing', prints all seven verbatim, each under the record's own kind token, with the apply_fee_waiver entry carrying the record's own conditionDescription.
theTwoSubstantiveAbsencesVF41NAMED: "Petitioner signature — Petition signature block." now prints as its own line.

findings.theThreeBARELINESWERENOTRESOLVED: The sign, pay_fee and apply_fee_waiver descriptions are "Required.", "None identified in the review." and "None identified." They print exactly as the record writes them, under a paragraph that says in terms that this is the record speaking rather than an omission, and that they are not resolved into an amount, a deadline or a procedure. No fee figure, deadline, waiver criterion, phone number, URL or court practice was invented. The existing 'Fees, service and hearings — what this packet does NOT tell you' section already tells the participant that no amount is stated and to ask the clerk's office; the new paragraph points at it rather than repeating a claim.
findings.aReadabilityProblemHANDLEDTHEFIX152WAY: Printed bare, three of the seven are unreadable standing alone. Each verbatim line therefore carries the record's own kind token immediately above it, so '> None identified in the review.' is legible as the pay_fee entry reporting an absence. The verbatim line itself is untouched, so exact-string verification still scores 7 of 7.

findings.whatWasWrong: disclosedVerbatimInGuide and everyRequiredBeforeFilingItemIsDisclosed were substring tests. "Required." is four words short of unique and already occurred inside step 8 of the ordered list, quoting the route census's signature requirement. findings.whatIsThereNow: disclosedAsItsOwnLine(): a description counts as disclosed only when, after stripping a leading '> ', '- ' or 'N. ' marker, it equals a whole line of the delivered guide. Measured on both versions of the guide: pre-repair 2/7 line-anchored (3/7 substring), post-repair 7/7 line-anchored (7/7 substring). The line-anchored figure reproduces VF41's own count of two.
